text_block_list.text:
Каррен Тян makes her debut without
any
trouble. Her social media is flooded
with
comments, and she enjoys all of the
support. Her
happiness doesn't last long,
though...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
On closer inspection, the majority of her
fans
aren't interested in her running. It's
now clear to
Каррен Тян that she needs
to increase the
attention on her races.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Instead of deciding on a short-term race
goal,
Каррен Тян decides to work on
increasing her
profile and name
recognition while continuing to
train.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
